name: WSH Bulk Taxonomy Editor for WooCommerce
author: Web Solutions Hub · websolutions.online

sections.description:
WSH Bulk Taxonomy Editor for WooCommerce updates product categories for the products you select in WooCommerce > Products.

Choose products, pick categories, preview the result, then apply the change in batches. The preview uses the same Add and Replace rules as Apply. Nothing is saved during preview.

This plugin edits product categories (product_cat) on the product itself. It does not edit product tags, attributes, or brands.

What you can do

  • Run it from the Products list bulk-actions menu.
  • Add categories without removing the ones already assigned.
  • Replace categories with the ones you select. If you select none, Apply asks you to confirm before it clears categories.
  • Search the category checklist, including child categories.
  • Preview the first 50 selected products. Apply still updates every selected product.
  • Process updates in batches of up to 200 products per request.
  • Clear the WooCommerce product cache after a successful update.

There is no product-count limit and no license check in this plugin.

Products and variations

Categories belong to the product, not to a variation. If a variation ID is submitted, the change is saved on its parent product. The same parent is only written once in a batch.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate WSH Bulk Taxonomy Editor for WooCommerce.
  3. WooCommerce must be active.
  4. Open Products, select one or more products, choose “WSH: Bulk Taxonomy Edit”, and click Apply.
sections.faq:
Does this edit tags, brands or attributes?

No. This plugin edits product categories only.

What is the difference between Add and Replace?

Add keeps the current categories and adds the selected ones. Replace sets exactly the selected categories. Replace with nothing selected clears categories after a second confirmation.

Does Preview save anything?

No.

Will this edit every product in the shop if I forget to select some?

No. An empty selection is rejected. Only the products you selected are considered, and each one must be a product you can edit.
